items.title: More Pinoy couples use contraceptives – CPD
items.description: The number of Filipino couples engaging in family planning through the use of contraceptives is increasing, the Commission on Population and Development said.

items.title: Ridon, Tolosa ordered: Explain sub judice breach
items.description: The Senate impeachment court has ordered Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon and private prosecutor Benjamin Tolosa Jr. to explain their perceived violations of the court’s sub judice rule.

items.title: Evidence enough to convict VP, says prosecution
items.description: Documentary and testimonial evidence against impeached Vice President Sara Duterte are enough to convict her regardless of whether the conviction threshold is maintained or not, according to the prosecution team of the House of Representatives.

items.title: Palace questions VP Sara’s capability to lead Philippines
items.description: Malacañang questioned the capability of Vice President Sara Duterte to lead the country after her camp claimed she is ready to succeed President Marcos.

items.title: ASEAN ministers sign Manila declaration on disaster management
items.description: Association of Southeast Asian Nations member states have signed the Manila Declaration, affirming their collective commitment to accelerating implementation of the ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response Work Programme 2026-2030; strengthening ASEAN accountability, monitoring, and learning for disaster resilience; and shaping the region’s disaster resilience agenda toward 2030 and beyond.

items.title: Growing Chinese surveillance in Philippines waters flagged
items.description: A maritime advocacy group has warned authorities of the increasing number of Chinese research vessels within Philippine waters, and called on the government not to ignore the development.

items.title: Marcos pushes release of class suspension guidelines
items.description: President Marcos wants the updated guidelines on class suspensions during weather disturbances and calamities fast-tracked to prevent confusion among parents and students, Malacañang said yesterday.

items.title: Palace backs SC stance on political dynasty bill
items.description: Malacañang agrees with the Supreme Court on the need to pass a bill banning political dynasties, saying the measure remains a priority of the Marcos administration.

items.title: Senate warned over revising impeachment vote threshold
items.description: Senators acting as judges in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte may face legal challenge including criminal cases if they proceed with changing the two-thirds voting requirement for her conviction, according to former presidential spokesman Salvador Panelo.

items.title: 8 Metro Manila hospitals reach full capacity for leptospirosis
items.description: Eight hospitals in Metro Manila have reached their full capacity for designated leptospirosis beds, the Department of Health reported yesterday.

items.title: ICC orders continued detention for Rodrigo Duterte  | The wRap
items.description: Today’s headlines: Rodrigo Duterte, Baste Duterte, Mark Zuckerberg

items.title: PH still deadliest country in Asia for environmental defenders for 13th straight year
items.description: The latest report from watchdog group Global Witness says violence against defenders in the Philippines in 2025 was linked to the government's counterinsurgency programs and extractive projects

items.title: Rappler Live Jam: Healy After Dark
items.description: Catch the 'Isip' hitmakers perform on Rappler Live Jam for the first time!

items.title: Team Japan forced to look at alternate accommodation options at home Asian Games
items.description: Abandoning plans to set up an Athletes' Village, 2026 Asian Games host Nagoya sets up alternative accommodation options, including a chartered cruise ship and  shipping-container style huts

items.title: [READOUT] Where businesses can plug into the Luzon Corridor
items.description: Of the initiative’s roughly $20 billion worth of disclosed opportunities, 99% are in transport, logistics, and energy projects, underscoring how much of the corridor’s high-tech potential still depends on getting the basics right first

items.title: EU Commission proposes under-13s social media ban
items.description: Under the proposal, which will need to be negotiated with EU countries and the European Parliament in the coming months before it can become law, accounts for children between 13 and 15 will be under parental control

items.title: NEA seeks extra P7 billion to eliminate non-technical system losses
items.description: NEA says eliminating non-technical system losses will require a phased transition, with cooperatives needing billions in loans for metering and other upgrades before they can absorb the costs

items.title: FACT CHECK: No lockdown in Malacañang after court ordered VP Sara’s arrest
items.description: No credible reports confirm that barricades and barbed wire were installed around Malacañang due to the issuance of Duterte's arrest warrant, contrary to the claim

items.title: After Senate passes bill, will 2026 barangay, SK polls be postponed?
items.description: The measure fixes the term of all elected barangay and SK officials to five years and moves the village and youth polls to the second Monday of November starting in 2028

items.title: FACT CHECK: INC rally misrepresented as protest against VP Sara arrest warrant
items.description: The video shows a commotion between police and members of the Iglesia ni Cristo during a June 2026 protest in support of Senator Rodante Marcoleta
